resources.string: Sign in to your Home Assistant server, then pick dashboard cards to float over any app on the car screen.
The car is usually on mobile data, so use an address it can reach from outside your home (Nabu Casa or your external URL).
Use a long-lived access token instead
Create one in Home Assistant under your Profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens.
Turn a card on to put its icon on screen. Tap the icon to show or hide the card. Hold a finger on the icon or the card, then drag, to move it.
No cards with entities were found on this dashboard.
This dashboard is generated automatically by Home Assistant, so it has no cards to pick. Open it in Home Assistant and choose “Take control”, or select another dashboard.
Close card popup when tapping outside
Show cards exactly as in Home Assistant
Tap the button to see lyrics in time with the song playing on this screen (Spotify first).

To let lyrics follow Spotify, open Spotify\'s Settings and turn on “Device Broadcast Status”, then play a song. Notification access also works and covers other music apps, but some car screens don\'t offer it.
This car screen has no notification access page. Use Spotify\'s own option instead: Spotify → Settings → Device Broadcast Status.
HA Overlay lyrics (reads the current song)
Log out of Home Assistant? Your pinned cards are kept.

This car screen has no standard permission page. Open Settings → Apps → HA Overlay and allow “Display over other apps”, or run this from a computer:\n\nadb shell appops set com.haoverlay SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow
